_about: Crypto-agility fix class per KB finding code (CB-24, model fx-1). Hand-written and reviewed: one row per code with the class, whether it is a capability code (the class depends on what the platform implements, so context rules in backend/utilities/cbom_sources/agility.py may change it), the justification (basis) and its sources. build_kb.py copies class, capability and basis into each KB entry as fix_class and fails on a missing or extra row.

QUANTUM_VULNERABLE.basis: a post-quantum replacement needs the platform (CA, clients, library, HSM, cloud service) to implement post-quantum signatures and key exchange; per-type context rules in agility.py (R-HW, R-HW-UNREAD, R-TYPE) decide where a fact is read
sources: https://www.openssh.org/pq.html (checked 2026-11-14: sntrup761x25519-sha512 is the default key exchange since OpenSSH 9.0; mlkem768x25519-sha256 was added in 9.9 and is the default since 10.0)
https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2025/06/aws-kms-post-quantum-ml-dsa-digital-signatures (checked 2026-11-14: AWS KMS supports ML-DSA keys, announced 2025-06-13; rule R-TYPE for AWS kms_key)

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/pqkeys.html (checked 2026-11-14): KMS has post-quantum signature keys and key-establishment keys (ENCAPSULATE_DECAPSULATE); encryption / key-agreement callers move to the new key type and API, code-fixed

https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2025/11/network-load-balancers-post-quantum-key-exchange-tls (checked 2026-11-14): ALB and NLB PQ-TLS security policies since 2025-11-21, opt-in per listener (configurable); Classic Load Balancer not covered

https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2025/11/aws-private-ca-post-quantum-digital-certificates (checked 2026-11-14): AWS Private CA can create post-quantum signature CAs since 2025-11-10 (configurable); RDS CAs and ACM certificates stay vendor-fixed
